cohort: The study included 56 pregnant women admitted to the ICU with real-time reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction-confirmed A/H1N1pdm or SARS-CoV-2 pneumonia.
finding: Respiratory failure due to A/H1N1pdm and SARS-CoV-2 infections in pregnancy is associated with high maternal mortality and fetal loss, and delayed hospital presentation independently predicted maternal death.
